# RedRouter: Speech-to-Text

Requires `RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL` and, when the instance requires one, `RED_ROUTER_API_KEY`. See
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reddb-io/red-router/main/skills/red-router/SKILL.md for setup.

## Discover

```bash
# Transcription models (audio entries with subtype "transcription")
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models \
  | jq '.data[] | select(.type=="audio" and .subtype=="transcription") | .id'
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" "$RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/info?id=<model-id>"
```

## Endpoint

`POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/audio/transcriptions` (OpenAI Whisper compatible,
`multipart/form-data`)

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | yes | `provider/model` id from discovery |
| `file` | yes | audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, webm, ogg, flac) |
| `language` | no | ISO-639-1 code, such as `en` |
| `prompt` | no | hint text to guide transcription |
| `response_format` | no | `json` (default), `text`, `verbose_json`, `srt`, `vtt`; provider dependent |
| `temperature` | no | 0 to 1 |

Use `POST /v1/audio/translations` (same form fields) to translate speech to English text.

## Example

```bash
curl -X POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -F "model=<model-id>" \
  -F "file=@audio.mp3" \
  -F "language=en"
```

JS (Node):

```js
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
const form = new FormData();
form.append("model", "<model-id>");
form.append("file", new Blob([await readFile("audio.mp3")]), "audio.mp3");
const r = await fetch(`${process.env.RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL}/v1/audio/transcriptions`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RED_ROUTER_API_KEY}` },
  body: form,
});
console.log((await r.json()).text);
```

## Response shape

Default (`response_format=json`): `{ "text": "..." }`. `verbose_json` adds segment and timing
details, and `srt` / `vtt` return subtitle text, when the chosen provider supports them.
